verdict.rationale: SigNoz documents managing dashboards as code, with the full dashboard spec available as JSON to read, download or hand-edit. The wording implies an API path, and service accounts grant programmatic API access for CI/CD. However, nothing shows alerts defined as code, a Terraform provider, or a repeatable provisioning workflow, and no OpenAPI spec was found. Missing for 10: alerts-as-code (JSON/API definitions for alert rules), Terraform provider, documented dashboard/alert provisioning API, evidence of repeatable automated provisioning, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can define dashboards and alerts as code (JSON models, Terraform, or API) and provision them repeatably

citations.quote: Edit a dashboard as JSON: read, copy, download or hand-edit the whole spec in the app, without going through the API.
Service accounts provide a secure way to grant programmatic API access to SigNoz without tying credentials to individual users. Use them for CI/CD pipelines, automation scripts, external integrations
